TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Approves the creation of a pending approval pricing rule
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: The transaction reads pricingRuleId, obtains ABKOR005 through getServiceLibrary(ABKOR005.class), and calls executeApprovePricingRule(pricingRuleId). The library retrieves the pricing rule by id, loads its active details and resolves each detail value, and validates that the rule exists and that its status is PAA, PAU or PAD. 2. Decisions and branches: If the rule status is PAA, or PAU with parentId equal to null, the rule is approved with status APR. If the status is PAU and parentId is not null, the parent rule is retrieved and, when present, its status is updated to DBU before approving the current rule with status APR. If the status is PAD, the rule is approved with status APD. 3. Libraries and methods invoked: The transaction invokes ABKOR005.executeApprovePricingRule. Inside that flow the repository retrieves the pricing rule, loads detail rows, resolves detail values, obtains audit ids, inserts audit records, and updates pricing rule statuses. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: If detail values cannot be resolved, if the pricing rule does not exist, if the rule status is not approvable, or if a status update fails, the library converts the PricingRuleException into addAdviceWithDescription and returns null. After the library call, the transaction sets severity EWR when the advice list is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: When the library returns a non-null PricingRuleDTO, the transaction assigns it to pricingRuleResponse. If the library returns null, pricingRuleResponse is not assigned.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Retrieves the pricing rule by id, loads its details, validates that it can be approved, updates the required statuses and audit records, and returns the pricing rule.
